title: xDrip not receiving IOB data from Nightscout
symptom: xDrip stopped showing IOB and pump data in the Extra Line, and basal data (blue line) is missing, although treatments (bolus and carbs) are still received from Nightscout. The issue appeared after upgrading to AAPS 2.7.
cause: The issue is related to an AAPS update, not xDrip, as reported by the user and confirmed by a maintainer.
evidence_quote: It seems to be related with the AAPS update, I've asked in their github page and I'm not the only one with this issue.
